name: Sentinel — restrained soldier prototype
description: Static rigid-part visual prototype with named body pivots. Olive-gray armor, charcoal undersuit, compact visor helmet and minimal sand accents. Not skinned, animated, or integrated with the Holodeck player controller. Source/render review: 9,884 triangles, seven materials, 1.896 m tall; structural export checks pass, motion and destination integration remain untested.
brief: A restrained super-soldier-like character prototype for Firearms Through Time; practical armor and human proportions, not over the top.
